verses.sloka: तथा सञ्चोदितः सूतो लक्ष्मणेन महात्मना ।तद्वाक्यमृषिणा प्रोक्तं व्याहर्तुमुपचक्रमे ।। ७.५१.१ ॥
verses.transliteration: tathā sañcoditaḥ sūto lakṣmaṇena mahātmanā ।tadvākyamṛṣiṇā proktaṁ vyāhartumupacakrame ।। 7.51.1 ॥

translations.english: Thus urged by the great-souled Lakshmana, the charioteer began to narrate the words spoken by the sage.

verses.sloka: पुरा नाम्ना हि दुर्वासा अत्रेः पुत्रो महामुनिः ।वसिष्ठस्याश्रमे पुण्ये वार्षिक्यं समुवास ह ।। ७.५१.२ ॥
verses.transliteration: purā nāmnā hi durvāsā atreḥ putro mahāmuniḥ ।vasiṣṭhasyāśrame puṇye vārṣikyaṁ samuvāsa ha ।। 7.51.2 ॥

translations.english: Formerly, a great sage named Durvasa, the son of Atri, resided in the sacred hermitage of Vasishtha during the rainy season.

verses.sloka: तमाश्रमं महातेजाः पिता ते सुमहायशाः ।पुरोहितं महात्मानं दिदृक्षुरगमस्त्वयम् ।। ७.५१.३ ॥
verses.transliteration: tamāśramaṁ mahātejāḥ pitā te sumahāyaśāḥ ।purohitaṁ mahātmānaṁ didṛkṣuragamastvayam ।। 7.51.3 ॥

translations.english: Your highly effulgent and very famous father went to that hermitage, desirous of seeing the great-souled priest.

verses.sloka: स दृष्ट्वा सूर्यसङ्काशं ज्वलन्तमिव तेजसा ।उपविष्टं वसिष्ठस्य सव्यपार्श्वे महामुनिम् ।। ७.५१.४ ॥
verses.transliteration: sa dṛṣṭvā sūryasaṅkāśaṁ jvalantamiva tejasā ।upaviṣṭaṁ vasiṣṭhasya savyapārśve mahāmunim ।। 7.51.4 ॥

translations.english: He (Rama) saw the great sage, who resembled the sun and blazed with splendor, seated on the left side of Vasistha.

verses.sloka: तौ मुनी तापसश्रेष्ठौ विनीतो ह्यभिवादयत् ।स ताभ्यां पूजितो राजा स्वागतेनासनेन च ॥
verses.transliteration: tau munī tāpasaśreṣṭhau vinīto hyabhivādayat ।sa tābhyāṁ pūjito rājā svāgatenāsanena ca ॥

translations.english: The king (Rama) humbly greeted those two sages, the best among ascetics, and was honored by them with a welcome and a seat.

verses.sloka: पाद्येन फलमूलैश्च उवास मुनिभिः सह ।। ७.५१.५ ॥
verses.transliteration: pādyena phalamūlaiśca uvāsa munibhiḥ saha ।। 7.51.5 ॥

translations.english: He (Rama) stayed with the sages, having been honored with water for his feet and offerings of fruits and roots.
translations.hindi: बली एवं अजेय ऋक्तराज जाम्बवन्त ओर गन्धमादन पर आपकी प्रीतियक्तदृष्टि रहनी चाहिए

verses.sloka: तेषां तत्रोपविष्टानां तास्ताः सुमधुराः कथाः ।बभूवुः परमर्षीणां मध्यादित्यगते ऽहनि ।। ७.५१.६ ॥
verses.transliteration: teṣāṁ tatropaviṣṭānāṁ tāstāḥ sumadhurāḥ kathāḥ ।babhūvuḥ paramarṣīṇāṁ madhyādityagate 'hani ।। 7.51.6 ॥

translations.english: As they sat there, various very pleasant conversations took place among the great sages during the midday.

verses.sloka: ततः कथायां कस्याञ्चित्प्राञ्जलिः प्रग्रहो नृपः ।उवाच तं महात्मानमत्रेः पुत्रं तपोधनम् ।। ७.५१.७ ॥
verses.transliteration: tataḥ kathāyāṁ kasyāñcitprāñjaliḥ pragraho nṛpaḥ ।uvāca taṁ mahātmānamatreḥ putraṁ tapodhanam ।। 7.51.7 ॥

translations.english: Then, during one of the conversations, the king (Rama), with folded hands and humility, spoke to that great-souled sage, the son of Atri, who was rich in asceticism.
translations.hindi: तथा अन्य जिन बानर बीरों ने मेरे लिये अपने प्राणों को हथेली पर रख कर युद्ध किआ है; हे झुम्रीब ! तुम उन सब को प्रीतियुक्तदृष्टि से देखना, कोई ऐसा काम न करना, झो इनको बुरा लगे

verses.sloka: भगवन्किं प्रमाणेन मम वंशो भविष्यति ।किमायुश्च हि मे रामः पुत्राश्चान्ये किमायुषः ।। ७.५१.८ ॥
verses.transliteration: bhagavankiṁ pramāṇena mama vaṁśo bhaviṣyati ।kimāyuśca hi me rāmaḥ putrāścānye kimāyuṣaḥ ।। 7.51.8 ॥

translations.english: Dasharatha asks the sage about the extent of his lineage, the lifespan of his son Rama, and the lifespans of his other sons.

verses.sloka: रामस्य च सुता ये स्युस्तेषामायुः कियद्भवेत् ।काम्यया भगवन्बूहि वंशस्यास्य गतिं मम ।। ७.५१.९ ॥
verses.transliteration: rāmasya ca sutā ye syusteṣāmāyuḥ kiyadbhavet ।kāmyayā bhagavanbūhi vaṁśasyāsya gatiṁ mama ।। 7.51.9 ॥

translations.english: Dasharatha further inquires about the lifespans of Rama's future sons and eagerly requests the sage to reveal the future course of his dynasty.
translations.hindi: क -——————-—-——-ज—-—— + क ०८. हे रा्सराज ! अब तुम भी जाओ । हम तुमको धर्मात्मा सममते हूँ | अतः तुस धर्मानुकूल वहाँ शासन करना । नगर वासियों, राक्षसा और भाई कुबेर के विषय में धसबुद्धि रखना

verses.sloka: तच्छ्रुत्वा व्याहृतं वाक्यं राज्ञो दशरथस्य च ।दुर्वासाः सुमहातेजा व्याहर्तुमुपचक्रमे ।। ७.५१.१० ॥
verses.transliteration: tacchrutvā vyāhṛtaṁ vākyaṁ rājño daśarathasya ca ।durvāsāḥ sumahātejā vyāhartumupacakrame ।। 7.51.10 ॥

translations.english: Having heard the words spoken by King Dasharatha, the exceedingly powerful sage Durvasa began to reply.

verses.sloka: शृणु राजन्पुरावृत्तं तदा देवासुरे युधि ।दैत्याः सुरैर्भर्त्स्यमाना भृगुपत्नीं समाश्रिताः ।। ७.५१.११ ॥
verses.transliteration: śṛṇu rājanpurāvṛttaṁ tadā devāsure yudhi ।daityāḥ surairbhartsyamānā bhṛgupatnīṁ samāśritāḥ ।। 7.51.11 ॥

translations.english: Durvasa instructs the king to listen to an ancient event from the time of the war between gods and asuras, when the demons, being oppressed by the gods, sought refuge with Bhrigu's wife.

verses.sloka: तया दत्ताभयास्तत्र न्यवसन्नभयास्तदा ।। ७.५१.१२ ॥
verses.transliteration: tayā dattābhayāstatra nyavasannabhayāstadā ।। 7.51.12 ॥

translations.english: Seeing the demons protected by her, the enraged lord of gods (Vishnu) cut off the head of Bhrigu's wife with his sharp-edged discus.

verses.sloka: तया परिगृहीतांस्तान्दृष्ट्वा क्रुद्धः सुरेश्वरः ।चक्रेण शितधारेण भृगुपत्न्याः शिरो ऽहरत् ।। ७.५१.१३ ॥
verses.transliteration: tayā parigṛhītāṁstāndṛṣṭvā kruddhaḥ sureśvaraḥ ।cakreṇa śitadhāreṇa bhṛgupatnyāḥ śiro 'harat ।। 7.51.13 ॥

translations.english: Then, the enraged upholder of the Bhrigu lineage, having suddenly seen his wife slain, cursed Vishnu, the destroyer of the family of enemies.
translations.hindi: वे कहने लगे, हे श्रीरामचन्द्र ! तम्हारी बुद्धि ब्रह्मा जी के. समान सदैव प्राणिमात्र का कल्याण करते वाली है । तुमभें सर्वोत्कृष्ट माधुर्य भी है । तुम्हारा पराक्रम भी अद्भुत हे

verses.sloka: ततस्तां निहतां दृष्ट्वा पत्नीं भृगुकुलोद्वहः ।शशाप सहसा क्रुद्धो विष्णुं रिपुकुलार्दनम् ।। ७.५१.१४ ॥
verses.transliteration: tatastāṁ nihatāṁ dṛṣṭvā patnīṁ bhṛgukulodvahaḥ ।śaśāpa sahasā kruddho viṣṇuṁ ripukulārdanam ।। 7.51.14 ॥

translations.english: Because you, overcome by anger, killed my inviolable wife, therefore you, O Janardana, will be born in the human world.
translations.hindi: इस प्रकार जब वे सब कह रहे थे कि, इसी बीच सं हनुमान जी ने प्रणाम कर श्रीरामचन्द्र जी से कहा-हे राजन्‌! हे | वीर ! तममें मेरी परम भक्ति और प्रीति सदा बनी रहै । मेरा मन तमको छोड़ और किसो में अनरक्त न हो )

verses.sloka: यस्मादवध्यां मे पत्नीमवधीः क्रोधमूर्च्छितः ।तस्मात्त्वं मानुषे लोके जनिष्यसि जनार्दन ।। ७.५१.१५ ॥
verses.transliteration: yasmādavadhyāṁ me patnīmavadhīḥ krodhamūrcchitaḥ ।tasmāttvaṁ mānuṣe loke janiṣyasi janārdana ।। 7.51.15 ॥

translations.english: There, you will experience separation from your wife for many years.

verses.sloka: तत्र पत्नीवियोगं त्वं प्राप्स्यसे बहुवार्षिकम् ।। ७.५१.१६ ॥
verses.transliteration: tatra patnīviyogaṁ tvaṁ prāpsyase bahuvārṣikam ।। 7.51.16 ॥

translations.english: Though his mind was afflicted by the curse, he (Vishnu) realized it was in accordance with his own divine will.
translations.hindi: द्‌ रघुनन्दन | जब तक तुम्हारा यह कथा इस ससार स॒ प्रचलित रहे, तब तक मेरे प्राण मेरे शरीर से कभी न्यारे न हों । हे पुरुषश्रेष्ठ श्रीराम ! तुम्हारा यह पवित्र चरित तथा यह कथा मुझे अप्सराए गाकर सुनाया कर

verses.sloka: शापाभिहतचेतास्स स्वात्मना भावितो ऽभवत् ।। ७.५१.१७ ॥
verses.transliteration: śāpābhihatacetāssa svātmanā bhāvito 'bhavat ।। 7.51.17 ॥

translations.english: Distressed by his own curse, Bhrigu worshipped that god (Vishnu), and the god, affectionate to his devotees and propitiated by penance, indeed declared that the curse was acceptable for the welfare of the worlds.

verses.sloka: अर्चयामास तं देवं भृगुः शापेन पीडितः ।तपसाराधितो देवो ह्यब्रवीद्भक्तवत्सलः ।लोकानां संहितार्थं तु तं शापं ग्राह्यमुक्तवान् ।। ७.५१.१९ ॥
verses.transliteration: arcayāmāsa taṁ devaṁ bhṛguḥ śāpena pīḍitaḥ ।tapasārādhito devo hyabravīdbhaktavatsalaḥ ।lokānāṁ saṁhitārthaṁ tu taṁ śāpaṁ grāhyamuktavān ।। 7.51.19 ॥

translations.english: The greatly effulgent one, who was cursed by Bhrigu in a previous birth, has indeed come here to be your son, O best among kings.

verses.sloka: इति शप्तो महातेजा भृगुणा पूर्वजन्मनि ।इहागतो हि पुत्रत्वं तव पार्थिवसत्तम ।। ७.५१.२० ॥
verses.transliteration: iti śapto mahātejā bhṛguṇā pūrvajanmani ।ihāgato hi putratvaṁ tava pārthivasattama ।। 7.51.20 ॥

translations.english: He will be renowned as Rama in the three worlds, O giver of honor, and will also obtain the great consequence caused by Bhrigu's curse.
translations.hindi: RR ) इस प्रकार की प्रेमपगी'वातें कहने वाले हनुमान जी को श्रीरामचन्द्र जी ने सिंहासन से उठ कर अपने हृदय से चिपटा लिग्रा । तदनन्तर वे बड़े स्नेह से उनसे बोले

verses.sloka: राम इत्यभिविख्यातस्त्रिषु लोकेषु मानद ।तत्फलं प्राप्स्यते चापि भृगुशापकृतं महत् ।। ७.५१.२१ ॥
verses.transliteration: rāma ityabhivikhyātastriṣu lokeṣu mānada ।tatphalaṁ prāpsyate cāpi bhṛguśāpakṛtaṁ mahat ।। 7.51.21 ॥

translations.english: Rama will be the lord of Ayodhya for a long time, and his followers will be happy and prosperous.
translations.hindi: तावत्ते भविता कीति: शरीरेऽप्यसवस्तथा । लोका हि यावत्स्थास्यन्ति तावत्स्थास्यन्ति मे कथाः।।२२ हे वानरोत्तम ! जे कुछ तुमने चाहा है, वही होगा । इसमें संशय नहीं हे। जब तक इस लोक में मेरो कथा प्रचलित रहैगी, तव तक तुम्हारी कीत्ति भी बनी रहेगी ओर तभी तक तुम भी शरीर धारण कर यहाँ वास करोगे ओर जब तक यह लोक रहेंगे, तब तक मेरी कथाएँ भी बनी रहेंगी

verses.sloka: अयोध्यायाः पती रामो दीर्घकालं भविष्यति ।सुखिनश्च समृद्धाश्च भविष्यन्त्यस्य ये ऽनुगाः ।। ७.५१.२२ ॥
verses.transliteration: ayodhyāyāḥ patī rāmo dīrghakālaṁ bhaviṣyati ।sukhinaśca samṛddhāśca bhaviṣyantyasya ye 'nugāḥ ।। 7.51.22 ॥

translations.english: Rama, having ruled the kingdom for eleven thousand years, will then go to the world of Brahma.

verses.sloka: दश वर्षसहस्राणि दश वर्षशतानि च ।रामो राज्यमुपासित्वा ब्रह्मलोकं गमिष्यति ।। ७.५१.२३ ॥
verses.transliteration: daśa varṣasahasrāṇi daśa varṣaśatāni ca ।rāmo rājyamupāsitvā brahmalokaṁ gamiṣyati ।। 7.51.23 ॥

translations.english: The extremely unconquerable Rama, having performed many prosperous Ashwamedha sacrifices, will establish many royal lineages in various places.
translations.hindi: हे वानर ! तुम्हारे एक ही उपकार पर ( प्रसन्न हो) में तुम्हें अपने प्राणदान करता हूँ । तुम्हारे बचे हुए उपकारों के लिए हम लोग तुम्हारे ऋणियाँ बने रहुँगे

verses.sloka: समृद्धैश्चाश्वमेधैश्च इष्ट्वा परमदुर्जयः ।राजवंशांश्च बहुशो बहून्संस्थापयिष्यति ।। ७.५१.२४ ॥
verses.transliteration: samṛddhaiścāśvamedhaiśca iṣṭvā paramadurjayaḥ ।rājavaṁśāṁśca bahuśo bahūnsaṁsthāpayiṣyati ।। 7.51.24 ॥

translations.english: Two sons will indeed be born to Rama through Sita, but they will be born elsewhere and not in Ayodhya; this is the truth, without a doubt.
translations.hindi: हे वानर ! तुमने जा उपकार किए हैं, वे मेरे अंगों में जीणे हो जाये । क्योंकि मनुष्य आपत्तियों ही से प्रत्युपकार के पात्र हुआ करते हें । अथवा जो तुमने मेर प्रति उपकार किए हैँ व सब मेरे हदय में बने रहेंगे । क्य कि उपकारी के प्रति बिना, क क का > उस पर विपत्ति पड़े, प्रस्युपकार किआ नहीं जा सकता (और सें यह नहीं चाहता कि,.तुस पर कभी विपत्ति[पड़े )

verses.sloka: द्वौ पुत्रौ तु भविष्येते सीतायां राघवस्य तु ।अन्यत्र न त्वयोध्यायां सत्यमेतन्नसंशयः ।। ७.५१.२५ ॥
verses.transliteration: dvau putrau tu bhaviṣyete sītāyāṁ rāghavasya tu ।anyatra na tvayodhyāyāṁ satyametannasaṁśayaḥ ।। 7.51.25 ॥

translations.english: Then, Rama will anoint Sita's two sons (as kings).
translations.hindi: कपिराज सुग्रीव ओर धर्मात्मा विभीषण जी, श्रीरामचन्द्र जी के गले से लिपट कर, उनसे मिल भेंटे। उस समय तीनों के, नेत्रों से.आऑँसू टपकने लगे और सब की गद्‌ गदूईबाणी हो गई

verses.sloka: सीतायाश्च ततः पुत्रावभिषेक्ष्यति राघवः ।। ७.५१.२६ ॥
verses.transliteration: sītāyāśca tataḥ putrāvabhiṣekṣyati rāghavaḥ ।। 7.51.26 ॥

translations.english: Having narrated the entire past and future of the king's lineage, the greatly effulgent great sage then became silent.
translations.hindi: सुवर्णमय शैलराज सुमेरु अपने ऊपर छिटकी हुई चन्द्रमा की चाँदनी से, जैसे शोभित होता है, वैसे ही हनुमान जी के वक्षःस्थल पर ,पड़ा हुषा वह हार, उनकी शोभा बढ़ाने लमा

verses.sloka: स सर्वमखिलं राज्ञो वंशस्याह गतागतम् ।आख्याय सुमहातेजास्तूष्णीमासीन्महामुनिः ।। ७.५१.२७ ॥
verses.transliteration: sa sarvamakhilaṁ rājño vaṁśasyāha gatāgatam ।ākhyāya sumahātejāstūṣṇīmāsīnmahāmuniḥ ।। 7.51.27 ॥

translations.english: When that sage became silent, King Dasharatha, having saluted the great sage, then returned to the excellent city (Ayodhya).

verses.sloka: तूष्णीम्भूते तदा तस्मिन्राजा दशरथो मुनौ ।अभिवाद्य महात्मानौ पुनरायात्पुरोत्तमम् ।। ७.५१.२८ ॥
verses.transliteration: tūṣṇīmbhūte tadā tasminrājā daśaratho munau ।abhivādya mahātmānau punarāyātpurottamam ।। 7.51.28 ॥

translations.english: This word, spoken by the sage there formerly, was heard by me and placed in my heart, and it will not be otherwise.

verses.sloka: एतद्वचो मया तत्र मुनिना व्याहृतं पुरा ।श्रुतं हृदि च निक्षिप्तं नान्यथा तद्भविष्यति ।। ७.५१.२९ ॥
verses.transliteration: etadvaco mayā tatra muninā vyāhṛtaṁ purā ।śrutaṁ hṛdi ca nikṣiptaṁ nānyathā tadbhaviṣyati ।। 7.51.29 ॥

translations.english: O Raghava, since things have come to this pass, you should not grieve, but rather be resolute, whether for Sita's sake or for your own, O best among men.

verses.sloka: एवं गते न सन्तापं कर्तुमर्हसि राघव ।सीतार्थे राघवार्थे वा दृढो भव नरोत्तम ।। ७.५१.३० ॥
verses.transliteration: evaṁ gate na santāpaṁ kartumarhasi rāghava ।sītārthe rāghavārthe vā dṛḍho bhava narottama ।। 7.51.30 ॥

translations.english: Having heard the charioteer's exceedingly wonderful words, he felt incomparable joy and exclaimed, "Excellent, excellent!"
translations.hindi: बड़े दुःख के साथ श्रीरामचन्द्र जी को छोड़ सके। उस समय उन सब के नेत्रों से आँसू टपक रहे थे और वे मारे दुःख के विहृल हो रहे थे ।! २६ ॥ कृतप्रसादास्तेनैवं राघवेण महात्मना । ` जग्मुः स्व, स्वं, गृहं सर्व देही देहमिव त्यजन्‌

verses.sloka: श्रुत्वा तु व्याहृतं वाक्यं सूतस्य परमाद्भुतम् ।प्रहर्षमतुलं लेभे साधु साध्विति चाब्रवीत् ।। ७.५१.३१ ॥
verses.transliteration: śrutvā tu vyāhṛtaṁ vākyaṁ sūtasya paramādbhutam ।praharṣamatulaṁ lebhe sādhu sādhviti cābravīt ।। 7.51.31 ॥

translations.english: Then, as the charioteer and Lakshmana were conversing on the path, the sun set, and they stayed in Keshini for the night. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीये आदिकाव्ये श्रीमदुत्तरकाण्डे एकपञ्चाशः सर्गः ।। 51 ।। Thus ends the fifty-first sarga of Uttara Kanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.

verses.sloka: ततः संवदतोरेवं सूतलक्ष्मणयोः पथि ।अस्तमर्के गते वासं केशिन्यां तावथोषतुः ।। ७.५१.३२ ।।
verses.transliteration: tataḥ saṁvadatorevaṁ sūtalakṣmaṇayoḥ pathi ।astamarke gate vāsaṁ keśinyāṁ tāvathoṣatuḥ ।। 7.51.32 ।।

translations.english: Thus ends the fifty-first canto of the Uttara Kanda in the Ramayana, the first poem, composed by the sage Valmiki.
